_comment: Edit these values, save, then run run_weekly_report.py (weekly picks) or backtester.py (season simulation). Set week to null to auto-detect the upcoming week from today's date.

finder._comment: source: sim | csv | api. Rules: leg_sizes is capped at 2; a leg needs model probability >= min_leg_prob and (model - implied) >= min_prob_gap (edge_basis implied = 1/decimal odds incl. vig, fair = de-vigged); same_game_policy: never | positive_only | any. markets lists market keys, labels or aliases from markets.json; the wildcards game, props and all are accepted (props = every player-prop market).

market_rules._comment: Per-market overrides of min_leg_prob / min_prob_gap / max_leg_odds / min_leg_edge. Keys are market keys, labels or aliases from markets.json, or the wildcards props / game; an explicit market beats a wildcard and anything not listed uses the global values above. Most over/under player props are priced near 50%, so the 68% floor will rarely let a prop through: tune these from the LEGS CLEARING THE FILTER BY MARKET table in the weekly report (or the dashboard's prop sliders).

backtester._comment: policies: flat:<pct> | flat$:<dollars> | kelly:<multiplier>; with_null adds a no-information control
